Question B-003-013-004.

Why the correct answer is right: With no microphone audio, an FM transmitter still produces its carrier, but there is no modulation riding on it.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "An unmodulated carrier": This is the correct choice because with no microphone audio, an FM transmitter still produces its carrier, but there is no modulation riding on it.
- sourceIndex 1: "A frequency-modulated carrier": This is a near-miss because it shifts attention from An unmodulated carrier. In FM deviation, FM receiver behaviour, and local VHF/UHF voice practice, carrier terminology is being applied to the wrong modulation condition here.
- sourceIndex 2: "An amplitude-modulated carrier": This answer would fit a different fault than An unmodulated carrier. In FM deviation, FM receiver behaviour, and local VHF/UHF voice practice, carrier terminology is being applied to the wrong modulation condition here.
- sourceIndex 3: "A phase-modulated carrier": This option confuses another station topic with An unmodulated carrier. In FM deviation, FM receiver behaviour, and local VHF/UHF voice practice, carrier terminology is being applied to the wrong modulation condition here.
